title: Sudoku solver
statementMd:
Solve a 9x9 Sudoku given as a list of 9 strings of digits with `.` for empty cells. The puzzle has exactly one solution. Return the solved board as 9 strings.

**Example:** `solve_sudoku(["53..7....", "6..195...", ".98....6.", "8...6...3", "4..8.…)` returns `["534678912", "672195348", "198342567", "859761423", "426853791", "713924856", …`.
hints: Backtrack on the empty cell with constraints.
